description:
**Phase C — Pure compaction core. Deps: C1, A1.**

Port from `tmp/pi-mono/.../compaction/compaction.ts`:
- `findTurnStartIndex` (lines 344-359)
- `findCutPoint` (lines 386-448)

Returns `%CutPointResult{first_kept_entry_index, turn_start_index, is_split_turn?}`.

Algorithm: walk **backwards** from end accumulating tokens until `>= keep_recent_tokens`; forward-scan to nearest valid cut point. Valid cuts: user / assistant / bash_execution / custom / branch_summary / compaction. **NEVER** at tool result.

Tests: turn-boundary cut, mid-turn split, single huge turn, cut against existing compaction boundary.
